title: 长对话 · 练习
goal: 听一遍对话，判断交谈目的、具体事实与后续行动。

points.label: 依据对话判断后续行动

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 材料长度、作答形式与总体评分描述；练习材料为原创。

lines.text: Hello, I'm organizing the photography club's exhibition. We booked the student hall for Friday, but the booking office says the floor needs repairs. Could the library help?
We have a meeting room upstairs. It holds thirty people, though we cannot allow pictures to be attached directly to its walls. What kind of display did you plan?
About twenty photographs, mostly local buildings. We expected visitors to walk around rather than sit through a talk. We could put the pictures on tables if necessary.
Tables would leave very little space for walking. We do have six standing display boards in storage. You could borrow them, provided someone collects them before Thursday afternoon.
That sounds promising. Is there a charge? We used nearly all our budget to print the photographs, so renting extra equipment would be difficult for us.
The room and boards are free for registered clubs. However, you must leave the room as you found it. Food is not allowed, although water is fine.
We can manage that. Our opening was advertised for six, and the library closes at eight. Would we have enough time to put everything away afterwards?
You can stay until half past eight to clear up. Please email the list of people helping you, so the evening staff know who should still be here.
I'll send that list this afternoon. First, I'll ask two club members to help collect the boards tomorrow morning. Then I can tell everyone about the new location.
Good. I'll reserve the room now. Once you have collected the boards, come to the desk and we will show you how to set them up safely.

items.stem: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: How to print photographs for a club.
How to find another venue for an exhibition.
How to repair the student hall floor.
How to attract members to a library club.
items.why: 原场地维修，双方讨论图书馆能否接办展览；照片已经印好，不是在商量印刷。

items.stem: Why does the library staff member suggest using display boards?
options: They can be attached directly to the walls.
They allow visitors to sit through a talk.
They are cheaper than printing photographs.
Tables would leave too little walking space.
items.why: 馆员指出桌子会占用行走空间，因而建议展板；墙上不能直接贴照片。

items.stem: What must the organizer send to the library?
options: The names of people helping with the exhibition.
A list of photographs that still need printing.
Payment for the room and display equipment.
A plan for serving food during the opening.
items.why: 馆员要求发来协助人员名单，便于晚间工作人员核对；场地和展板免费。

items.stem: What will the organizer probably do first after the conversation?
options: Move the exhibition back to the student hall.
Collect the boards alone on Friday evening.
Ask club members to help collect the boards.
Ask the booking office to delay the repairs.
items.why: 组织者说 First 要找两名社员帮忙次日上午取展板，之后再通知新地点。

lines.text: I start my placement at the community radio station next week. What should I prepare before the first day?
Of course. You will initially help our producer organize recorded interviews. Have you used audio editing software before, or would a short introduction be useful?
I have edited music for a college project, but never an interview. I can cut files, although I need help deciding which parts of a conversation to keep.
That is exactly what we will cover. Technical speed matters less than keeping a speaker's meaning clear. Removing a pause is fine; removing a qualification can change the message.
Should I bring my laptop? It has the program I used at college. I could practice over the weekend if you send me a sample recording.
You can bring it for taking notes, but recordings must stay on our office computers. We will give you a practice file when you arrive, with no personal information in it.
I understand. The letter says I should come at nine on Monday. Is that when the whole team has its weekly planning meeting, or will I meet the producer first?
The team meeting starts at ten. Come to reception at nine, and I will show you the building before introducing you to the producer. Bring the placement form from your college.
I have the form ready. In that case, I will review my notes on interviewing this weekend rather than edit a sample at home. That should help me understand the choices.
Yes, especially the section on asking follow-up questions. We can teach you the controls here. What matters most is listening carefully before deciding that a piece of speech is unnecessary.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of the conversation?
options: To choose music for a college project.
To arrange an interview with a radio listener.
To prepare a student for a work placement.
To change the station's weekly meeting time.
items.why: 学生开头询问实习第一天前应准备什么，后文围绕工作内容与报到安排展开。

items.stem: What does the staff member emphasize about editing interviews?
options: Preserving what the speaker means.
Removing every pause from a recording.
Finishing each file as quickly as possible.
Using the student's own editing program.
items.why: 工作人员强调保持说话人的原意，并用删掉限制条件会改变意思作说明；速度并非首要标准。

items.stem: What will happen at nine on Monday?
options: The student will join the weekly team meeting.
The producer will send a recording to the college.
The student will edit an interview at home.
The staff member will show the student the building.
items.why: 九点先在前台见面并参观；团队会议十点才开始。

items.stem: What will the student probably do during the weekend?
options: Copy office recordings onto a laptop.
Review notes about interviewing.
Complete the first recorded interview.
Attend the station's planning meeting.
items.why: 学生明确改为周末复习采访笔记；录音须留在办公室电脑中，不能在家剪辑。
